detail.longDescription: RE: https:// xoxo.zone/@robotspacer/1174016 76816657137 So there’s some good news on my recent complaints about the toolbar area in Safari: the WebKit team is interested in addressing this shortcoming, at least on the iPhone Duo: https:// webkit.org/blog/18486/webkit-f eatures-for-safari-27-1/ They’ve asked for feedback, so I’ve updated my post: https:// mikepiontek.com/journal/iphone -duo-safari.html#nov4 This seems like a good approach to me? This would make it easy to update existing sites that already use safe areas correctly. Regardless I look forward to seeing what @ jensimmons and team come up with. # Safari # WebDev
